meta.name: seo-firecrawl
meta.description: Full-site crawling, scraping, and site mapping via Firecrawl MCP. Use when user says "crawl site", "map site", "full crawl", "find all pages", "broken links", "site structure", "discover pages", "JS rendering", or needs site-wide analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 全站爬取并生成站点地图，用于SEO分析
copy.tagline_en: Crawl entire sites and generate sitemaps for SEO analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need comprehensive site structure and content analysis for SEO

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以爬取整个网站、发现所有页面、抓取单页内容（含 JS 渲染），并在网站内搜索。
howto.when: 当你提到“爬取网站”、“网站地图”、“查找所有页面”、“死链”、“网站结构”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我爬取 example.com 的所有页面，限制 50 页。
say.note: Claude 会执行全站爬取并返回页面内容。

say.text: 搜索 example.com 上关于“SEO”的页面。
say.note: Claude 会在该网站内搜索相关页面。

say.text: 抓取 example.com/about 页面，输出 markdown 格式。
say.note: Claude 会抓取单页并返回 markdown 内容。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can crawl entire websites, discover all pages, scrape single pages with JS rendering, and search within a site.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "crawl site", "map site", "find all pages", "broken links", "site structure", etc.

say_en.text: Crawl example.com with a limit of 50 pages.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a full-site crawl and return page content.
Claude will search within the site for relevant pages.
Claude will scrape the single page and return markdown.
